firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I have been running tests to understand how the API works, namely the rate limit. The arc3 documentation in https://docs.arcprize.org/rate_limits mentions a rate limit of 600: "Rate limits are set at 600 requests per minute (RPM)." but I'm not sure if that applies to the competition.

My guess is that the gateway used by submission enforces a rate limit and we don't need to worry about enforcing it ourselves in our submission code. Is that the case? If yes, what is that rate limit? If not, what is the rate limit that is enforced by some other means and that we should adhere to to avoid errors?

The offline Arcade doesn't enforce any rate limits but if we want to assess the performance of our methods, we need to replicate the conditions of the submission, namely the rate limit.
